_comment: DRISHTI Job Scheduling / Cron descriptors (Phase 14 Part B / matrix row 20). Catalyst crons are created via the Job Scheduling SDK or the Console (there is no standalone CLI-deployed cron config file), so this is the single reviewed source of the intended schedules, consumed by a setup step at enable time. EVERY cron below is enabled=false so it never fires and incurs no charge until its owning phase turns it on. Cron expression format is Quartz-like: 'sec min hour day-of-month month day-of-week'. Times are the project timezone (Asia/Kolkata).

crons.name: drishti-reconcile-nightly
crons.description: Nightly Data Store/Stratus reconciliation, backup/export, failed-job replay, stale temp cleanup, temporary AWS GPU/Batch shutdown checks, budget/health evidence.

crons.name: drishti-forecast-daily
crons.description: Scheduled aggregate/spatiotemporal forecast + backfill dispatch to the protected AWS adapter (baseline/TimesFM/ST-GNN/hotspot/near-repeat).

crons.name: drishti-embeddings-refresh-weekly
crons.description: Approved-source embeddings + similarity index shadow-build/eval/atomic-switch (routed through AppSail/AWS Batch). Reuses the ops cron entrypoint until a dedicated function is enabled.

crons.name: drishti-board-export (RESERVED)
crons.description: Investigation Board locked-snapshot/export housekeeping. RESERVED — the owning function is created and enabled by Prompt 16.

crons.name: drishti-hazard-feed (RESERVED)
crons.description: Hazard feed ingestion + freshness heartbeat. RESERVED — created and enabled by Prompt 17.

crons.name: drishti-hazard-forecast (RESERVED)
crons.description: Hazard forecast review + alert. RESERVED — created and enabled by Prompt 17. Never auto-warns or issues an all-clear.

crons.name: drishti-resource-allocation (RESERVED)
crons.description: Resource allocation + routing planning. RESERVED — created and enabled by Prompt 17. Never auto-dispatches.
